# Notic

> Sticky notes one hover away. Notic is a private, offline menu-bar app for macOS 14 or later that keeps short-lived notes and to-dos at the edge of every display.

Canonical site: https://notic.yagyaraj.com/
Current version: 1.0
Developer: Yagyaraj Lodhi
Contact: hey@yagyaraj.com

## Product facts

- At rest, notes appear as a row of coloured dashes on the right, left, or bottom edge of each display.
- Hovering fans the notes out as colour tabs without taking focus from the current app.
- Clicking a tab opens a resizable plain-text editor beside it; edits autosave.
- Typing [] at the start of a line creates a checkbox to-do; ⇧⌘T adds one and ⌘Return toggles it.
- Eight pastel colours and six fonts, including the handwritten Patrick Hand.
- A searchable two-pane library holds active and archived notes; deletes can be undone for ten seconds.
- Global shortcuts: ⌥⌘N new note, ⌥⌘L library, ⌥⌘A archive, ⌃⌥⌘H hide or show.
- No account, no network requests, no telemetry, and no Accessibility, Screen Recording, or Input Monitoring permission.
- Installation uses a DMG: open it, then drag Notic into Applications.
